_note: Pass 282.67. Player-facing Dimension Archive text, keyed by reality title (case-insensitive). A title not listed falls back to the project's own description.

blurbs.HoloCore: The layered core under HoloVerse. Climb its strata and see what holds the hub together.
blurbs.HoloShell: An observatory world. Explore the shell and the sky it was built to watch.
blurbs.HoloTactics: A complete holographic tactics game, waiting on its own board.
blurbs.HoloMap: Orbit's dimension: a full holographic map you can explore from the inside.
blurbs.Vector Arena: A living combat arena from the Utopia war. Waves grow, arenas reshape themselves, and three-phase Guardians wait at the end of every set.
blurbs.Utopia Conflict // Source Vector Arena: Utopia Conflict, the full war for Utopia that Vector Arena grew out of.
blurbs.UTOPIA // LENS TOUR: A guided lens tour through Utopia as it was, before it fell.
blurbs.Anatomic: A first-person anatomy lab built from glowing ASCII matter. Wounds persist, damage can be reversed, and every strike is recorded.
blurbs.Anomaly Sequence: Wave-gated spacetime combat. Steer through plasma ricochets, clear the wave, and only then does the next warp open.
blurbs.The Archivist: A zero-gravity 4D Mind Archive. Fifty-five story realities drift in their own shells, and you can thrust freely in any direction between them.
blurbs.Mirror's Limbo: Mirror's limbo, a liminal in-between where staying unseen and reading people is how you get through.
blurbs.Vector Wars: Vector Wars. A separate reality that opens in its own window; close it to come back.
blurbs.HoloUtopia // Holo-Utopia Civic Ring: HoloUtopia, a living civic ring. Its citizens work, build and keep the city running around you.
blurbs.HoloUtopia: HoloUtopia, a living civic ring. Its citizens work, build and keep the city running around you.
